messages.subject: shiny app with R worldmap
parts:
Hello,
I'm curentlly trying to create a shiny app with R worldmap that displays the number of certain cars in each country.
I've already joined the data with the map using
 
vw_karte<-joinCountryData2Map(Volkswagen.df,
                           nameJoinColumn="country",
                           joinCode="ISO2")
 
I reapeated this for my 5 data.frames that all contain the countrys and the vakues and saved them in: vw_map, daimler_map, opel_map, mazda_mapand audi_map.
 
Now I'd like to create a shiny app, where I can display a worl map that shows one caer brand at a time and where you can choose which map is displayed.
It tries this code:
 
ui.R
 
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Installierte Basis"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("brand", label = "choose brand:",
                  choices = c(vw_map,daimler_map,opel_map, mazda_map,audi_map),
                  selected = vw-map)),
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("carmap")
    )
  )
))
 
server.R
 
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
 
 
  output$carmap <- renderPlot({
carmap<- mapCountryData( as.character(input$brand),
                          nameColumnToPlot="number_of_cars",
                          oceanCol="lightblue",
                          missingCountryCol="white",
                          colourPalette="topo",
                          addLegend=FALSE,
                          mapRegion= "world",
                          catMethod="logFixedWidth")
  })
})
 
 
But it doesn't work at all. What am I doing wrong.
Is it even possible to select the data one wants to plot in a shiny app.
It would be great if someone could help me, because I really don't know what to do anymore :)
